$comment: Curated beacon holdings (PLAN.md §6 step 3). Matched against OSM beacons by ref or by case-insensitive name substring. civs is a weight vector over civilization keys and is normalised at build. verify=true means a researcher has not checked the holdings yet; the numbers are a first guess from public collection descriptions.

beacons.note: Musée Saint-Raymond, Toulouse. Gaulish gold torcs (Fenouillet, Vieille-Toulouse), Roman sculpture from Chiragan. Etruscan and Phoenician shares are a guess for imported material.
Musée Georges-Labit, Toulouse. Egyptian antiquities and Asian art. The Asian shares stand in for later Chinese and Indian material and need a researcher's eye.
